questions.question: The dimensional formula of Planck's constant is:
questions.explanation: E = hν, so h = E/ν. Energy has dimensions [ML²T⁻²] and frequency [T⁻¹], so h = [ML²T⁻¹].

questions.question: The error in the measurement of the radius of a sphere is 2%. The error in the calculation of its volume is:
Which of the following pairs of physical quantities has the same dimensions?
questions.explanation: Torque = r × F has dimensions [ML²T⁻²], the same as energy (work). They are different quantities with the same dimensions.

questions.question: If force (F), velocity (V) and time (T) are taken as fundamental units, the dimensions of mass are:
questions.explanation: F = ma = m·V/T, so m = F·T/V = [FV⁻¹T].

questions.question: In an experiment, the percentage errors in the measurement of A, B, C and D are 1%, 2%, 3% and 4% respectively. The maximum percentage error in X = A²B^(1/2) / (C^(1/3) D³) is:
A ball is thrown vertically upward with a speed of 20 m/s. Taking g = 10 m/s², the maximum height reached by the ball is:
questions.explanation: At the highest point v = 0. Using v² = u² − 2gh: 0 = 400 − 20h, so h = 20 m.

questions.question: A projectile is fired at an angle of 45° with the horizontal. The elevation angle of the projectile at its highest point, as seen from the point of projection, is:
questions.explanation: At the highest point, H = u²sin²θ/2g and horizontal distance R/2 = u²sin2θ/2g. tan α = H/(R/2) = (tan θ)/2 = 1/2, so α = tan⁻¹(1/2).

questions.question: The displacement of a particle is given by x = 3t² + 2t + 1 (in metres, t in seconds). Its acceleration at t = 2 s is:
questions.explanation: v = dx/dt = 6t + 2 and a = dv/dt = 6 m/s², constant for all t.

questions.question: Which of the following hormones is secreted by the corpus luteum in large amounts?
questions.explanation: After ovulation, the ruptured follicle becomes the corpus luteum, which secretes large amounts of progesterone needed to maintain the endometrium.

questions.question: The cells that provide nutrition to the developing sperms in the seminiferous tubules are:
questions.explanation: Sertoli cells line the seminiferous tubules and nourish the germ cells; Leydig (interstitial) cells secrete androgens.

questions.question: Fertilisation in humans usually takes place in the:
options: Ampullary region of the fallopian tube
questions.explanation: The ovum and sperm meet in the ampullary region (ampulla-isthmic junction) of the fallopian tube, where fertilisation takes place.

questions.question:
Match the following and choose the correct option:
A. Trophoblast   i. Embedding of blastocyst
B. Cleavage   ii. Group of cells that differentiate into the embryo
C. Inner cell mass   iii. Outer layer of blastocyst
D. Implantation   iv. Mitotic division of zygote
